ex.en: It's normal to experience workplace crushes, but remember to stay professional.
ex.zh: 在職場上對人產生好感很正常，但記得保持專業。

ex.en: We want to create a safe and friendly workplace.
ex.zh: 我們希望打造一個安全友善的職場。

ex.en: Workplace stress can affect your health.
ex.zh: 職場壓力會影響你的健康。

workplace.en: the place where people do their jobs

ex.en: Despite adversity, the architect achieved worldwide fame.
ex.zh: 儘管身處逆境，那位建築師仍然享譽全球。

ex.en: The song became a worldwide hit.
ex.zh: 這首歌在全球爆紅。

worldwide.en: happening or known in every part of the world

ex.en: Korean entertainment culture is popular worldwide.
ex.zh: 韓國的娛樂文化在全世界都很受歡迎。

ex.en: The company has over 5,000 employees worldwide.
ex.zh: 這家公司在全球有超過五千名員工。

worldwide.en: in every part of the world

ex.en: Women make up half of our workforce.
ex.zh: 女性占我們員工的一半。

ex.en: The company plans to reduce its workforce by 10%.
ex.zh: 公司計畫裁減一成人力。

ex.en: Training helps build a skilled workforce.
ex.zh: 訓練有助於培養技術熟練的勞動力。

workforce.en: all the people who have jobs, or all the people who work for a company

ex.en: I think it is worthwhile to see this film twice.
ex.zh: 我覺得這部電影值得看兩次。

ex.en: The hard work was worthwhile because I passed the exam.
ex.zh: 努力是值得的，因為我考過了。

ex.en: Volunteering is a worthwhile experience.
ex.zh: 當志工是很值得的經驗。

worthwhile.en: good enough to be worth the time or effort you spend on it

ex.en: These garments are made of 100 percent wool.
ex.zh: 這些衣服是百分之百羊毛製成的。

ex.en: Her dress was made of coarse wool.
ex.zh: 她的洋裝是用粗羊毛做的。

ex.en: These fabrics are made of pure wool.
ex.zh: 這些布料是純羊毛的。

wool.en: the soft thick hair of sheep, or cloth made from it

ex.en: Cats love to run after balls of wool.
ex.zh: 貓很喜歡追毛線球。

ex.en: My grandmother bought some wool to knit a scarf.
ex.zh: 我奶奶買了一些毛線要織圍巾。

wool.en: thick thread made from sheep hair, used for knitting

wool.zh: pull the wool over someone's eyes：矇騙某人

ex.en: You cannot pull the wool over my eyes.
ex.zh: 你騙不了我的。

ex.en: He tried to pull the wool over the customers' eyes.
ex.zh: 他試圖矇騙顧客。

wool.en: to trick someone by hiding the truth from them

ex.en: Please complete page ten in your workbook.
ex.zh: 請完成練習簿的第十頁。

ex.en: The workbook comes with an answer key.
ex.zh: 這本練習簿附有解答。

workbook.en: a book with exercises that students write in

ex.en: Save the workbook before closing Excel.
ex.zh: 關閉 Excel 前先儲存活頁簿。

ex.en: This workbook has five worksheets.
ex.zh: 這個活頁簿有五個工作表。

workbook.en: a computer file that contains several pages of tables and numbers

ex.en: Due to the worsening weather, the departure was delayed.
ex.zh: 由於天氣轉壞，出發時間延後了。

ex.en: The economic situation of the country worsened.
ex.zh: 這個國家的經濟狀況惡化了。

ex.en: Traffic tends to worsen during rush hour.
ex.zh: 交通在尖峰時段往往會更糟。

worsen.en: to become less good, or to make something less good

ex.en: The company's financial woes continue.
ex.zh: 公司的財務困境仍在持續。

ex.en: Tom told me his tale of woe.
ex.zh: 湯姆向我訴苦。

woe.en: great sadness, or a problem that causes trouble

ex.en: Your proposal is worthy of being considered.
ex.zh: 你的提議值得考慮。

ex.en: His behavior is worthy of respect.
ex.zh: 他的行為值得尊重。

worthy.zh: 有價值的、可敬的、當之無愧的

ex.en: The money will go to a worthy cause.
ex.zh: 這筆錢會捐給有意義的公益。

ex.en: She was a worthy winner of the award.
ex.zh: 她得這個獎實至名歸。

worthy.en: good and deserving respect or support

ex.en: The teacher handed out a grammar worksheet.
ex.zh: 老師發了一張文法練習卷。

ex.en: Please finish the worksheet before Friday.
ex.zh: 請在星期五前完成學習單。

worksheet.en: a piece of paper with questions or exercises for students

ex.en: Click the tab to add a new worksheet in Excel.
ex.zh: 點選分頁就能在 Excel 新增工作表。

ex.en: Copy the data into the second worksheet.
ex.zh: 把資料複製到第二張工作表。

worksheet.en: one page of a computer file that holds tables and numbers

ex.en: The difference is this: he works harder than you.
ex.zh: 差別在於：他比你更努力工作。

ex.en: I worked hard in order to support my family.
ex.zh: 我努力工作來養家。

work.en: to do a job or use effort to do something

ex.en: You have to get this work finished by noon.
ex.zh: 你必須在中午前完成這項工作。

ex.en: I have a lot of work to do today.
ex.zh: 我今天有很多工作要做。

work.en: a job, or the things you do as part of your job

ex.en: The printer isn't working.
ex.zh: 印表機壞了。

ex.en: Your plan worked perfectly.
ex.zh: 你的計畫完全奏效。

work.en: to operate correctly, or to give the result you want

ex.en: This museum has many works by Picasso.
ex.zh: 這間美術館有很多畢卡索的作品。

ex.en: His latest work is a novel about Taiwan.
ex.zh: 他最新的作品是一部關於台灣的小說。

work.en: a piece of art, music or writing made by someone

ex.en: English is spoken in many countries around the world.
ex.zh: 世界上許多國家都說英語。

ex.en: Taipei 101 was once the tallest building in the world.
ex.zh: 台北101曾是世界最高的大樓。

world.en: the earth and all the people and countries on it

ex.en: He has a strong influence over the business world.
ex.zh: 他在商界很有影響力。

ex.en: She is well known in the fashion world.
ex.zh: 她在時尚界很有名。

world.en: a particular area of life or activity and the people in it

ex.en: The woman sitting over there is his present wife.
ex.zh: 坐在那邊的女士是他現在的妻子。

ex.en: Out of the 6 members, a third are women.
ex.zh: 六名成員中有三分之一是女性。

ex.en: In that age, men and women wore similar hairstyles.
ex.zh: 在那個時代，男女的髮型很相似。

ex.en: I am not sure how to pronounce the word.
ex.zh: 我不確定這個字怎麼唸。

ex.en: 80% of all English words come from other languages.
ex.zh: 英文單字中有八成來自其他語言。

word.en: a single unit of language that has a meaning

ex.en: Mike said a few words by way of suggestion.
ex.zh: 麥克說了幾句話作為建議。

ex.en: Can I have a word with you?
ex.zh: 我可以跟你談一下嗎？

word.en: a short talk or a few things that you say

ex.en: You can take her at her word on that.
ex.zh: 這件事你可以相信她說的話。

ex.en: He gave me his word that he would help.
ex.zh: 他向我保證會幫忙。

word.en: a promise that you will do something

ex.en: In other words, we need more time.
ex.zh: 換句話說，我們需要更多時間。

ex.en: In other words, the project failed.
ex.zh: 換句話說，這個專案失敗了。

word.en: used to say the same thing in a different and clearer way

ex.en: You don't need to worry about such a thing.
ex.zh: 你不必擔心這種事。

ex.en: She was worried that she might miss the train.
ex.zh: 她擔心會趕不上火車。

ex.en: Don't worry. I told you everything would be OK.
ex.zh: 別擔心，我跟你說過一切都會沒事的。

worry.en: to feel anxious about problems or things that might go wrong

ex.en: No worries, I will send you to the elevator.
ex.zh: 沒關係，我送你到電梯口。

ex.en: Money is my biggest worry right now.
ex.zh: 錢是我現在最大的煩惱。

worry.en: a feeling of fear about problems, or something that makes you feel this

ex.en: I wonder which of the runners will come first.
ex.zh: 我在想哪位跑者會跑第一。

ex.en: I cannot help wondering if he will come on time.
ex.zh: 我忍不住想他會不會準時到。

ex.en: I've always wondered what it'd be like to have siblings.
ex.zh: 我一直很好奇有兄弟姊妹會是什麼感覺。

wonder.en: to ask yourself questions about something you are not sure of

wonder.zh: I wonder if…：（客氣請求）不知道能不能……

ex.en: I wonder if you have something to write with.
ex.zh: 不知道你有沒有可以寫字的東西？

ex.en: I wonder if you could help me with this.
ex.zh: 不知道你能不能幫我處理這件事？

wonder.en: to politely ask whether someone is able or willing to do something

ex.en: No wonder you're tired; you worked all night.
ex.zh: 難怪你這麼累，你熬了一整夜。

ex.en: No wonder the store is so crowded today.
ex.zh: 難怪今天店裡這麼擠。

wonder.en: used to say that something is not surprising

ex.en: The workers complained when their working hours were extended.
ex.zh: 工時被延長時，工人們都在抱怨。

ex.en: This company allows its workers to work from home.
ex.zh: 這家公司允許員工在家工作。

ex.en: The rescue worker searched the area, looking for the child.
ex.zh: 救難人員搜索那一帶，尋找那個孩子。

worker.en: a person who does a job for a company or for pay

ex.en: This dictionary is very expensive, but is worth buying.
ex.zh: 這本字典雖然很貴，但值得買。

ex.en: That music is worth listening to many times.
ex.zh: 那首音樂值得一聽再聽。

ex.en: If it is worth doing, do it well.
ex.zh: 值得做的事就要做好。

worth.en: good enough to deserve the time, money or effort spent on it

ex.en: The frame itself is worth more than the picture.
ex.zh: 畫框本身比畫還值錢。

ex.en: This painting is worth a great deal of money.
ex.zh: 這幅畫很值錢。

worth.en: having a certain value in money

ex.en: I have self-studied half a semester's worth of German.
ex.zh: 我自學了半學期份量的德文。

ex.en: He bought 500 dollars' worth of books.
ex.zh: 他買了五百美元的書。

worth.en: the amount of something that a certain sum of money or period of time can get

ex.en: The show was wonderful, but the tickets were too expensive.
ex.zh: 這場表演很精彩，但門票太貴了。

ex.en: This is the most wonderful present I have ever received.
ex.zh: 這是我收過最棒的禮物。

ex.en: Thank you very much for the wonderful dinner last night.
ex.zh: 非常感謝您昨晚美好的晚餐。

ex.en: The statue was carved from a block of cherry wood.
ex.zh: 這座雕像是用一塊櫻桃木雕成的。

ex.en: In the village we still heat our homes with wood.
ex.zh: 在村子裡，我們還是燒木頭讓家裡保暖。

ex.en: This table is made of solid wood.
ex.zh: 這張桌子是實木做的。

wood.en: the hard material from trees, used to make things or burn

ex.en: One day she met a wolf in the woods.
ex.zh: 有一天，她在樹林裡遇到一匹狼。

ex.en: He lives in the woods all by himself.
ex.zh: 他獨自住在樹林裡。

wood.en: a large area with many growing trees

ex.en: He cleansed the wound before putting on a bandage.
ex.zh: 他先清洗傷口，再包上繃帶。

ex.en: "I need to inspect the wound," said the doctor.
ex.zh: 「我需要檢查一下傷口。」醫生說。

wound.en: an injury to the body where the skin is cut or broken

ex.en: A wounded whale washed up on the beach.
ex.zh: 一頭受傷的鯨魚被沖上海灘。

ex.en: Many thousands on both sides had been wounded.
ex.zh: 雙方都有好幾千人受傷。

wound.en: to hurt someone's body with a weapon or in a fight

ex.en: The garden was surrounded by a wooden fence.
ex.zh: 花園被木頭圍籬圍了起來。

ex.en: How much does the wooden chair cost?
ex.zh: 那張木椅要多少錢？

ex.en: My wooden bed is actually quite heavy.
ex.zh: 我的木床其實很重。

ex.en: She was worried that she might miss the train.
ex.zh: 她擔心她趕不上火車。

ex.en: Helen is very worried about her daughter.
ex.zh: Helen很擔心她的女兒。

ex.en: I am not the least bit worried.
ex.zh: 我一點也不擔心。

worried.en: anxious because you think something bad might happen

ex.en: I attended a writing workshop last weekend.
ex.zh: 我上週末參加了一個寫作工作坊。

ex.en: The workshop will teach you basic coding skills.
ex.zh: 這個工作坊會教你基本的程式技能。

workshop.en: a meeting where people learn by taking part in practical activities

ex.en: I adapted the garage for use as a workshop.
ex.zh: 我把車庫改成工作室。

ex.en: An old worker was found repairing machinery in the workshop.
ex.zh: 有人看到一位老工人在車間裡修理機器。

workshop.en: a room or building where things are made or repaired

ex.en: Each employee has an adjustable workstation.
ex.zh: 每位員工都有可調整的工作區。

ex.en: Please log out before leaving your workstation.
ex.zh: 離開工作站前請先登出。

workstation.en: a desk or area where one person does their job, often with a computer

ex.en: The wording of the notice should be clearer.
ex.zh: 這份通知的措辭應該更清楚。

ex.en: Legal staff reviewed the wording of the agreement.
ex.zh: 法務人員審閱了協議的用字。

wording.en: the words that are chosen to say something

ex.en: My workload has doubled since my colleague left.
ex.zh: 同事離職後，我的工作量多了一倍。

ex.en: We need to share the workload more fairly.
ex.zh: 我們需要更公平地分擔工作量。

workload.en: the amount of tasks that a person has to do

ex.en: The museum shows the works of many local artists.
ex.zh: 博物館展出許多本地藝術家的作品。

ex.en: He has read all her works.
ex.zh: 她的作品他全都讀過。

ex.en: My uncle works at the steel works nearby.
ex.zh: 我叔叔在附近的鋼鐵廠工作。

ex.en: The gas works closed down years ago.
ex.zh: 那間煤氣廠幾年前就關閉了。

ex.en: My mother is a working woman with two jobs.
ex.zh: 我母親是個身兼兩份工作的職業婦女。

ex.en: The working hours are from nine to six.
ex.zh: 工作時間是九點到六點。

ex.en: Is the elevator working today?
ex.zh: 電梯今天有在運作嗎？

ex.en: We need a working computer for the class.
ex.zh: 我們上課需要一台能正常使用的電腦。

ex.en: Wow, this view is more beautiful than I imagined!
ex.zh: 哇，這個景色比我想像的還美！

ex.en: Wow, you finished the whole book in one day?
ex.zh: 哇，你一天就讀完整本書了？

ex.en: A wolf howled somewhere in the distance last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚遠處傳來狼嚎聲。

ex.en: The story is about a wolf who tries to trick three little pigs.
ex.zh: 這個故事講的是一隻想欺騙三隻小豬的狼。

ex.en: He wolfed down his lunch because he was late for class.
ex.zh: 他因為上課快遲到了，就狼吞虎嚥地吃完午餐。

ex.en: The kids wolfed the pizza before anyone else could take a slice.
ex.zh: 孩子們把披薩吃得一乾二淨，別人都沒機會拿。

ex.en: I do a thirty-minute workout every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上做三十分鐘的運動。

ex.en: This workout is great for building strong legs.
ex.zh: 這套訓練很適合鍛鍊腿部肌力。

ex.en: Many people worship at this temple every morning.
ex.zh: 許多人每天早上都到這間廟裡拜拜。

ex.en: The fans worship their favorite singer.
ex.zh: 粉絲們崇拜他們最愛的歌手。

ex.en: The church is a place of worship.
ex.zh: 教堂是做禮拜的地方。

ex.en: His worship of money ruined his life.
ex.zh: 他對金錢的崇拜毀了他的人生。

ex.en: We went for a walk in the quiet woodland.
ex.zh: 我們在寧靜的林地裡散步。

ex.en: Many birds live in the woodland near our village.
ex.zh: 我們村子附近的林地住著許多鳥類。

ex.en: The bird pulled a worm out of the wet soil.
ex.zh: 那隻鳥從潮濕的土裡拉出一條蟲。

ex.en: After the rain, worms came out onto the sidewalk.
ex.zh: 下雨後，蚯蚓爬到了人行道上。

ex.en: He put a worm on the hook and cast his line.
ex.zh: 他把一條蟲掛在魚鉤上，然後甩出釣線。

ex.en: The child wormed through the crowd to get to the front.
ex.zh: 那個孩子在人群中鑽到前面去。

ex.en: He wormed his way under the fence.
ex.zh: 他慢慢鑽過了圍籬下方。

would.zh: 會（假設語氣，will 的過去式）

ex.en: If I had more time, I would learn another language.
ex.zh: 如果我有更多時間，我會學另一種語言。

ex.en: She said she would call me after the meeting.
ex.zh: 她說開完會後會打給我。

ex.en: I would like a glass of water, please.
ex.zh: 請給我一杯水。

ex.en: Would you like to sit by the window?
ex.zh: 你想坐靠窗的位子嗎？

ex.en: When I was a child, we would visit the beach every summer.
ex.zh: 我小時候，我們每年夏天都會去海邊。

ex.en: He would read a story to me before I went to sleep.
ex.zh: 他以前常在我睡前念故事給我聽。

ex.en: It is worrying that he hasn't called us yet.
ex.zh: 他到現在還沒打給我們，真讓人擔心。

ex.en: The doctor said the test results were nothing worrying.
ex.zh: 醫生說檢查結果沒有什麼值得擔心的。

ex.en: There is a worrying lack of clean water in the area.
ex.zh: 這個地區缺乏乾淨的水，情況令人憂心。

ex.en: Stop worrying about the exam and get some sleep.
ex.zh: 別再擔心考試，去睡一下吧。

ex.en: She keeps worrying that she forgot to lock the door.
ex.zh: 她一直擔心自己忘了鎖門。

ex.en: The wounded bird could not fly.
ex.zh: 那隻受傷的鳥不會飛。

ex.en: Doctors rushed to help the wounded soldier.
ex.zh: 醫生們趕去救助那名受傷的士兵。

ex.en: He felt wounded by her harsh words.
ex.zh: 他被她刻薄的話傷到了心。

ex.en: The weather today is worse than yesterday.
ex.zh: 今天的天氣比昨天更糟。

ex.en: His cough got worse during the night.
ex.zh: 他的咳嗽在夜裡變得更嚴重。

ex.en: He plays the piano worse than his sister does.
ex.zh: 他鋼琴彈得比他姊姊差。

ex.en: It hurts worse when I walk.
ex.zh: 我走路時痛得更厲害。

ex.en: If the rain continues, worse may come.
ex.zh: 如果雨繼續下，更糟的情況可能還會發生。

ex.en: Things looked bad, but worse was still ahead.
ex.zh: 情況看起來很糟，但更糟的還在後頭。

ex.en: A workman came to fix the broken pipe in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 一位工人來修理廚房裡破掉的水管。

ex.en: The workman packed his tools and left at five.
ex.zh: 那位工人收拾好工具，五點就離開了。

ex.en: We went for a walk in the woods behind the house.
ex.zh: 我們在房子後面的樹林裡散步。

ex.en: The children got lost in the woods but found their way home.
ex.zh: 孩子們在樹林裡迷了路，但後來找到了回家的路。

ex.en: He tried to woo her with flowers and poems.
ex.zh: 他試著用花和詩來追求她。

ex.en: The company is trying to woo young customers.
ex.zh: 這家公司正努力爭取年輕顧客。

ex.en: Cities often woo big businesses with tax breaks.
ex.zh: 城市常用減稅來拉攏大企業。

ex.en: She wore a warm woollen scarf in winter.
ex.zh: 冬天她圍著一條溫暖的羊毛圍巾。

ex.en: My grandmother knitted me woollen socks.
ex.zh: 我奶奶為我織了羊毛襪。

ex.en: The shop sells woollens from local farms.
ex.zh: 這間店販售本地農場產的毛織品。

ex.en: Pack your woollens; it will be cold up north.
ex.zh: 把你的毛衣帶著，北部會很冷。

ex.en: The kids played wonderfully together all afternoon.
ex.zh: 孩子們整個下午玩得非常開心。

ex.en: The cake tasted wonderfully sweet.
ex.zh: 這蛋糕嚐起來甜得美妙。

ex.en: She sings wonderfully for her age.
ex.zh: 以她的年紀來說，她唱得好極了。

ex.en: The old coins turned out to be worthless.
ex.zh: 那些舊硬幣結果一文不值。

ex.en: He felt worthless after losing his job.
ex.zh: 失業後，他覺得自己一無是處。

ex.en: Without a warranty, the product is nearly worthless.
ex.zh: 沒有保固的話，這個產品幾乎沒有價值。

ex.en: A baby grows inside its mother's womb for about nine months.
ex.zh: 嬰兒在母親的子宮裡成長約九個月。

ex.en: The doctor showed us the baby on the screen inside the womb.
ex.zh: 醫生讓我們在螢幕上看到子宮裡的寶寶。

ex.en: Ancient rivers were the womb of many great civilizations.
ex.zh: 古代的河流是許多偉大文明的發源地。

ex.en: The small garage was the womb of the company's first product.
ex.zh: 那間小車庫孕育了公司的第一項產品。

ex.en: In Victorian England, poor families were sometimes sent to the workhouse.
ex.zh: 在維多利亞時代的英國，貧窮家庭有時會被送進濟貧院。

ex.en: The novel describes the harsh life inside a workhouse.
ex.zh: 這本小說描寫了濟貧院裡艱苦的生活。

ex.en: The house stands on a wooded hillside.
ex.zh: 那棟房子坐落在樹木茂密的山坡上。

ex.en: We hiked through a thickly wooded valley.
ex.zh: 我們健行穿過一座林木茂密的山谷。

ex.en: She has worn that coat every winter.
ex.zh: 她每年冬天都穿那件外套。

ex.en: He had worn glasses since childhood.
ex.zh: 他從小就戴眼鏡。

ex.en: The carpet is worn near the door.
ex.zh: 門口附近的地毯磨損了。

ex.en: These shoes are badly worn.
ex.zh: 這雙鞋磨損得很嚴重。

ex.en: You look worn out after the long trip.
ex.zh: 長途旅行後你看起來很疲憊。

ex.en: The worn faces of the workers showed how tired they were.
ex.zh: 工人們憔悴的臉龐顯示他們有多累。

ex.en: Traveling widened my worldview.
ex.zh: 旅行拓展了我的世界觀。

ex.en: Their different worldviews led to long debates.
ex.zh: 他們不同的世界觀引發了長時間的辯論。

ex.en: The monk gave up all worldly possessions.
ex.zh: 那位僧人放棄了所有世俗的財物。

ex.en: She cares little for worldly success.
ex.zh: 她不太在乎世俗的成功。

worldly.zh: 見多識廣的；老於世故的

ex.en: After years of travel, he became a worldly man.
ex.zh: 旅行多年後，他變成一個見多識廣的人。

ex.en: My worldly aunt always gives good advice about life.
ex.zh: 我見多識廣的阿姨總是給我很好的人生建議。

ex.en: He enjoys woodwork and makes furniture on weekends.
ex.zh: 他喜歡木工，週末會自己做家具。

ex.en: The old house has beautiful carved woodwork around the windows.
ex.zh: 這棟老房子的窗邊有漂亮的雕刻木作。

ex.en: The sheep had thick woolly coats.
ex.zh: 這些綿羊有厚厚的羊毛。

ex.en: She wore a woolly hat and gloves in the cold.
ex.zh: 天冷時她戴著毛線帽和手套。

ex.en: His woolly answer didn't explain anything.
ex.zh: 他含糊不清的回答什麼也沒說明。

ex.en: The plan is still a bit woolly and needs more detail.
ex.zh: 這個計畫還有點模糊，需要更多細節。

ex.en: The doctor said the test result was a bit worrisome.
ex.zh: 醫生說檢查結果有點令人擔心。

ex.en: It is worrisome that prices keep rising so fast.
ex.zh: 物價持續快速上漲真令人擔心。

ex.en: We need a workable plan before the deadline.
ex.zh: 我們在截止日前需要一個可行的計畫。

ex.en: Her idea is simple but workable.
ex.zh: 她的點子簡單，但行得通。

ex.en: Virginia Woolf was an English writer born in London.
ex.zh: 維吉尼亞．吳爾芙是出生於倫敦的英國作家。

ex.en: We read a short essay by Woolf in literature class.
ex.zh: 我們在文學課上讀了吳爾芙的一篇短文。

ex.en: The table wobbles because one leg is shorter.
ex.zh: 這張桌子因為有一隻腳比較短而搖晃。

ex.en: The toddler wobbled and then fell onto the soft rug.
ex.zh: 小朋友搖搖晃晃，然後跌坐在柔軟的地毯上。

ex.en: I felt a slight wobble when I rode the bike.
ex.zh: 我騎腳踏車時感覺有一點搖晃。

ex.en: There was a wobble in her voice as she began to speak.
ex.zh: 她開口說話時，聲音有點顫抖。

ex.en: The children stared at the wondrous sight of the northern lights.
ex.zh: 孩子們盯著極光這奇妙的景象。

ex.en: She told us wondrous stories about faraway lands.
ex.zh: 她對我們講了許多關於遠方國度的奇妙故事。

workday.zh: 工作日；一天的工作時間

ex.en: The workday starts at nine and ends at six.
ex.zh: 一天的工作從九點開始、六點結束。

ex.en: Please send the package within two workdays.
ex.zh: 請在兩個工作天內寄出包裹。

ex.en: That was the worst movie I have ever seen.
ex.zh: 那是我看過最爛的電影。

ex.en: This is the worst storm in ten years.
ex.zh: 這是十年來最嚴重的暴風雨。

ex.en: Our village was worst hit by the flood.
ex.zh: 我們村子是受洪水災情最嚴重的地方。

ex.en: Of all the players, he performed worst today.
ex.zh: 在所有球員中，他今天表現得最差。

ex.en: Hope for the best, but prepare for the worst.
ex.zh: 抱最好的希望，但做最壞的打算。

ex.en: The worst is over, and things are getting better.
ex.zh: 最糟的時候已經過去，情況正在好轉。

ex.en: The worsening weather forced us to cancel the trip.
ex.zh: 天氣持續惡化，我們只好取消旅行。

ex.en: His cough is worsening, so he should see a doctor.
ex.zh: 他的咳嗽越來越嚴重，應該去看醫生。

ex.en: The workmanship of this table is excellent.
ex.zh: 這張桌子的做工非常精緻。

ex.en: We guarantee the quality of our workmanship.
ex.zh: 我們保證我們的工藝品質。

ex.en: Rosemary has a woody stem.
ex.zh: 迷迭香有木質的莖。

ex.en: We walked through a quiet, woody valley.
ex.zh: 我們走過一個安靜而林木繁茂的山谷。

ex.en: This table is wobbly, so put something under the leg.
ex.zh: 這張桌子搖搖晃晃的，把東西墊在桌腳下吧。

ex.en: The toddler took a few wobbly steps toward her mother.
ex.zh: 小寶寶搖搖晃晃地朝媽媽走了幾步。

ex.en: Hundreds of worshippers gathered at the temple.
ex.zh: 數百名信徒聚集在廟裡。

ex.en: The church was quiet, with only a few worshippers inside.
ex.zh: 教堂很安靜，裡面只有幾位做禮拜的人。

ex.en: My workmate and I often have lunch together.
ex.zh: 我和我的同事常常一起吃午餐。

ex.en: She is a friendly workmate who always helps new staff.
ex.zh: 她是個很友善的同事，總是幫助新進人員。

ex.en: The team was woefully unprepared for the final exam.
ex.zh: 這個團隊對期末考毫無準備，令人嘆息。

ex.en: Our supplies were woefully small for such a long trip.
ex.zh: 對這麼長的旅程來說，我們的補給少得可憐。

ex.en: She entered womanhood with confidence.
ex.zh: 她自信地步入成年女性的階段。

ex.en: The film explores the meaning of womanhood in different cultures.
ex.zh: 這部電影探討不同文化中女性身分的意義。

ex.en: Hundreds of worshipers gathered at the temple.
ex.zh: 數百名信徒聚集在寺廟裡。

ex.en: The church was quiet except for one lone worshiper.
ex.zh: 教堂裡很安靜，只有一位獨自禱告的人。

ex.en: Sheep grazed on the open wold above the village.
ex.zh: 羊群在村莊上方開闊的高地上吃草。

ex.en: The wind blew hard across the bare wold.
ex.zh: 風猛烈地吹過光禿禿的荒野。

ex.en: A woodpecker was tapping on the tree outside my window.
ex.zh: 一隻啄木鳥在我窗外的樹上啄個不停。

ex.en: The woodpecker uses its strong beak to find insects in the bark.
ex.zh: 啄木鳥用強壯的喙在樹皮裡找昆蟲。

ex.en: She wore a warm woolen sweater on the cold morning.
ex.zh: 寒冷的早晨，她穿了一件保暖的羊毛毛衣。

ex.en: Grandpa gave me woolen socks for winter.
ex.zh: 爺爺送我羊毛襪過冬。

ex.en: The shop sells woolens made by local farmers.
ex.zh: 這家店販售當地農民製作的毛織品。

ex.en: Pack your woolens before the trip to the mountains.
ex.zh: 去山上旅行前，先把毛織衣物收好帶上。

ex.en: The Woodstock music festival took place in 1969.
ex.zh: 伍德斯托克音樂節於一九六九年舉行。

ex.en: My uncle says he saw a famous band at Woodstock.
ex.zh: 我叔叔說他在伍德斯托克看過一個著名的樂團。

ex.en: As was his wont, he took a walk before breakfast.
ex.zh: 一如他的習慣，他在早餐前散了步。

ex.en: She rose at dawn, as was her wont.
ex.zh: 她一如往常在黎明時起床。

workhorse.zh: 主力；做粗重工作的人或物

ex.en: This old truck has been the workhorse of our farm for years.
ex.zh: 這輛舊卡車多年來一直是我們農場的主力。

ex.en: She is the workhorse of the team and never complains.
ex.zh: 她是團隊裡的苦幹實幹者，從不抱怨。

ex.en: She cooked the vegetables in a hot wok.
ex.zh: 她用燒熱的炒菜鍋炒蔬菜。

ex.en: A wok is great for stir-fried dishes.
ex.zh: 炒菜鍋很適合做快炒料理。

ex.en: He kept his tools on the workbench in the garage.
ex.zh: 他把工具放在車庫的工作檯上。

ex.en: The workbench was covered in sawdust.
ex.zh: 工作檯上滿是木屑。

ex.en: He took up woodworking as a hobby after he retired.
ex.zh: 他退休後把木工當成嗜好。

ex.en: My uncle teaches woodworking at the community center.
ex.zh: 我叔叔在社區中心教木工。

ex.en: My father is a workaholic who rarely takes a day off.
ex.zh: 我爸爸是個工作狂，很少休假。

ex.en: Being a workaholic can hurt your health.
ex.zh: 當工作狂可能傷害你的健康。

ex.en: The park becomes a winter wonderland after the first snow.
ex.zh: 第一場雪後，公園變成了冬季仙境。

ex.en: The kids saw the toy store as a wonderland.
ex.zh: 孩子們把那家玩具店當成奇幻樂園。

ex.en: In the movie, the crew travels through a wormhole to another galaxy.
ex.zh: 電影裡，太空人穿過蟲洞前往另一個星系。

ex.en: Physicists study the wormhole as a possible shortcut through space.
ex.zh: 物理學家把蟲洞當成穿越太空的可能捷徑來研究。

ex.en: They shared a long, wordless hug at the station.
ex.zh: 他們在車站無言地擁抱了很久。

ex.en: The film is almost wordless, telling its story through images.
ex.zh: 這部電影幾乎沒有台詞，靠畫面來說故事。
